pageDescription: FAS Modular Rear Carrier Systems – Flexible grid system with over 20 modules for individual expedition equipment.

overview.title: One System. Endless Possibilities.
overview.description: Our patented grid system enables fast, tool-free mounting of equipment modules. Each module locks securely into place and can be swapped in seconds – perfect for changing requirements on long expeditions.
features: Tool-free module exchange in under 60 seconds
Compatible with all FAS vehicle platforms
Expandable with additional modules at any time

modules.title: Available Modules
modules.subtitle: Choose the modules for your individual configuration

items.title: Platform Base
items.description: The foundation of our modular system. The robust aluminum platform provides maximum stability and flexibility for mounting all add-on modules. 200×200 mm grid system for secure locking.

items.title: Sectional Folding Platform
items.description: Modular platform system for flexible cargo solutions. Tool-free assembly and dismantling for maximum flexibility on every expedition.

items.title: Motorcycle Extension Module
items.description: Enables safe transport of motorcycles on the rear carrier. Robust construction and easy assembly for maximum flexibility.

items.title: Quad Extension Module
items.description: Enables safe transport of quads on the rear carrier. Robust construction and easy assembly for maximum flexibility.

featuredSection.title: Complete Solution for Maximum Flexibility
featuredSection.description: Discover the revolutionary HT-XL grid system – engineered for expedition professionals who demand the highest standards in reliability and modularity. Every module can be mounted and changed tool-free.
